about: Evaluation semantics of the formula language, ported from the Go engine's tests (engine/*_test.go and formula/*_test.go). Each case names the Go test it comes from; where a Go expectation existed only because of float64 or Go's map order, the case expects the exact or ordered result and its name says so. 'value' is a value tree compared exactly (numbers by value), 'near' a number within a tolerance, 'error' the evaluation error's code and, optionally, part of its message template ('message'), of its English text ('english'), its fields and guards. 'lookups' names a table set below, or 'stub' for the predicate stub; without it lookups are unavailable. 'recorded' lists the lookups the receipt records.
